absenceReason: Free agents have not been fetched from MFL yet
method: MFL freeAgents export; §6 minimum by experience, computed in Go
howCounted: Every player MFL lists as a free agent, joined to the held players directory for name, position, NFL team, age and draft year. Experience is this season minus the draft year; a player with no real draft year is shown at the rookie minimum and marked. The minimum is the Official Rulebook §6 table by experience. Free agents the directory does not know (team units) are left out.
